text:
lucy: Quick sync — we need to finalize what runtime/infra will emit so Console can build per-model/route performance panels (P50/P95/P99, TTFT, tokens/sec). Can we align on a minimal metric+label set?

David: +1. Runtime currently emits per-request latencies and token counts, but labels are sparse. I propose: `route_id`, `model_id`, `model_variant`, `deploy_stage`, `region`, `seq_len_bucket`.

maria: Important: ingestion cost if we emit full request-level traces for everything. We'll need pre-aggregations or sampling. Suggest emitting rollup counters/gauges per 1s and 1m windows for high-card routes and raw samples for low-volume ones.

tom: From Console UX: we want to support filtering by route, by model, and quick compare across two model_variants. Also need time-range compare and percentiles (P50/P95/P99) + TTFT as a separate metric. UI will read percentiles from aggregated series.

jess: Also product wants SLO buckets by customer tier (free/standard/enterprise). Can `customer_tier` be added as a label or will that explode cardinality?

David: `customer_tier` is useful but cardinality risk is real. Alternative: emit `route_owner_tier` only for enterprise routes or provide a mapping service in metrics pipeline that enriches low-card events with tier for known routes.

lucy: Proposal (compact): metrics naming and labels:
```
redwood.runtime.request.latency_ms_bucketed{route_id,model_id,model_variant,deploy_stage,region,seq_len_bucket}
redwood.runtime.ttft_ms{route_id,model_id,model_variant,deploy_stage}
redwood.runtime.tokens_per_sec{route_id,model_id,deploy_stage}
```
Percentiles computed from `latency_ms_bucketed` via pipeline. For tokens/sec we can emit both instantaneous and 1m-avg.

maria: Implementation notes: pipeline wants buckets (log2 buckets for latencies) + 1s counters for tokens. For high-volume routes we should switch to aggregated series only (no per-request label set). We'll maintain an allowlist for full-cardinality traces.

tom: On Console side we'll need a contract: which metrics are 'required' vs 'optional'. Required -> drives default panels. Optional -> advanced toggles. That helps SRE not to over-emit.

david: I'll open a telemetry PR with the emitter change. Rough sketch here: <https://github.com/redwood/telemetry/pull/1234> (WIP). Needs schema for `seq_len_bucket` and `model_variant` format.

jess: Can we also expose an alerting panel that maps breaches (P95 > threshold) to recent deploys/variant rollouts? Product wants faster rollback signals.

lucy: Yep — will add a `deploy_version` label to a sampled subset so we can correlate spikes with deploys without full-cardinality churn.

telemetry-bot: deploy pipeline: telemetry-emitter v2 deployed to canary cluster at 2025-06-11T09:40:12Z :rocket:

maria: Action items: 1) David — PR + emitter schema (due EOD Tue). 2) Maria — sampling/allowlist design for cost (due Thu). 3) Tom — draft Console panel wireframe (due next Wed). 4) Lucy/Jess — define SLO thresholds per tier (sync Fri).

lucy: Thanks, everyone — syncing this into the telemetry spec doc and PR comments. If anyone has blocking concerns tag me or drop comments on the PR. :eyes:
